title: Implement meter component and indicator cluster
description:
Create Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h and Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp implementing `class MeterComponent : public juce::Component, private juce::Timer`.

Responsibilities:
- Stereo output meters driven by TelemetryState leftPeak/rightPeak with an RMS underlay from leftRms/rightRms. Display in dB with a floor of -60 dB, converting from linear with `dB = 20 * std::log10(std::max(level, 1.0e-6f))`.
- Ballistics on the GUI side only: instantaneous rise, exponential decay per timer tick, and a peak-hold marker that resets after 1500 ms.
- An indicator cluster reading activity, density, contraction, bloom, and the safety flag, each rendered as a labelled bar or lamp using colours from CustomLookAndFeel.
- `startTimerHz(30)` in the constructor, `stopTimer()` handled by the Timer destructor; each `timerCallback()` reads TelemetryState atomics and calls `repaint()`.

The component takes a `TelemetryState&` by reference in its constructor and stores the reference. It must never poll audio buffers, never include a DSP header, and never block.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Telemetry/TelemetryState.h (exact accessor names and types created in j.2)
- Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h (shared colour constants created in j.1)
- JUCE/modules/juce_events/timers/juce_Timer.h and JUCE/modules/juce_gui_basics/components/juce_Component.h (vendored signatures for timerCallback, paint, resized)

Do not register this file in CMakeLists.txt; task j.8 owns that registration.
acceptance_criteria: Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h declares class MeterComponent deriving from juce::Component and juce::Timer and taking a TelemetryState& constructor argument
Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp defines paint, resized, and timerCallback and calls startTimerHz in the constructor
timerCallback in Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp reads only TelemetryState accessors and calls repaint, performing no audio processing
Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp converts linear level to dB with a -60 dB display floor
Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h and .cpp include Source/Telemetry/TelemetryState.h and Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h and include no header from Source/DSP
Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp renders indicators for activity, density, contraction, bloom, and the safety flag
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: include any DSP header or read audio buffers from the GUI

allowed: choose meter decay constant, timer rate, and peak-hold duration
choose bar versus lamp rendering for each indicator
forbidden: add a second telemetry channel or new atomics
perform DSP analysis in the GUI
